summary: Svelte scopes ordinary component styles so they mainly affect markup from that component.

blocks.text: Svelte scopes ordinary component styles so they mainly affect markup from that component. This helps avoid accidental changes elsewhere.
Use a Svelte 5 project. Save a single example as App.svelte unless file names say otherwise. The Svelte compiler is required; these snippets do not run as plain HTML or JavaScript.

items: The component style block chooses its `h2` and `p` elements.
`line-height: 1.6` gives paragraph lines space relative to their text size.

blocks.text: The component heading is navy and its paragraph has roomy line spacing.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Global styles need a deliberate global rule. Do not assume a child component's private markup will match a parent rule.
